name: Tapo L900-5 (EU)

matter.note: Neither the product page nor the EU user guide mentions Matter; absence is not proof, so left unconfirmed.

apple_home.note: The page only mentions Siri Shortcuts, not Apple Home or HomeKit.

google_home.note: Voice control through Google Assistant, set up with the Tapo app's third-party services.

alexa.note: Voice control through Amazon Alexa, set up with the Tapo app's third-party services.

home_assistant.note: Listed under Tapo light strips in Home Assistant's official TP-Link integration, which connects locally and needs TP-Link account credentials.

hubRequired.note: TP-Link says no hub is required; it connects to home Wi-Fi.

localControl.note: Home Assistant's TP-Link integration connects locally without the TP-Link cloud; TP-Link's own app control is cloud-based.

colorType.note: Over 16 million colours plus warm white and cool daylight.

lengthM.note: 5 m strip (5000 mm); it can be cut, but cut-off pieces can't be reused.

multiZone.note: TP-Link doesn't describe separate colours along one strip, so this is unconfirmed.

power.note: Input 220–240 V, output 12 VDC 1.0 A, max 13.5 W.

summary: Tapo L900-5 (EU) pairs with Alexa and Google Assistant once you link them in the Tapo app, and with Home Assistant through the TP-Link integration. This 5 m strip runs on 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi with no hub and shows 16 million colours plus warm and cool white. TP-Link doesn't mention Apple Home, SmartThings or Matter.
caveats: The strip can be cut, but the cut-off pieces can't be reused.
TP-Link doesn't list Apple Home, SmartThings or Matter for this strip.
